besluite.fout: Three repeated 'of' right after the 'besluit jy of' (whether) read woodenly and make the reader stumble.
besluite.rede: A comma list with one final 'of' is natural Afrikaans and keeps the same four outputs.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: 'Drade maak' and ''n skakelaar beheer' are two full clauses, so the AWS 2017 comma is required.
'in die nag' is plain, natural Afrikaans; 'snags' is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: 'wanneer om te ry' copies English 'when to drive'.
besluite.rede: The modal clause is the natural Afrikaans construction and keeps the same meaning, without splitting the sentence.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses, which makes the double 'en' stumble.
besluite.rede: 'Stroombane werk' and 'daar is die bron' are separate clauses, so the comma is required; 'gewoonlik' is untouched.

besluite.fout: 'lighuis' follows English 'lighthouse'; the standard Afrikaans word is 'vuurtoring'.
besluite.rede: Same object, standard word, and it links naturally to 'bo-in die toring' in the same block; the protected warning wording is untouched.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: 'breek hy die pad' and 'so hou die sel langer' are two full clauses, so the comma is required.

besluite.fout: 'met 'n hand' breaks the fixed expression 'met die hand'.
besluite.rede: The fixed expression is clearly better and the meaning stays the same; the block title is not changed.

besluite.fout: 'die ding wat gebeur' is vague, and 'toe' is the open/closed wording the decided skakelaar definition deliberately avoids.
besluite.rede: Changing the circuit term from 'toe' to 'heel' is a terminology decision tied to a decided shared definition, so the writer must fix it.
'een stroombaan' already says the loop and wire share one circuit; 'dieselfde' is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: 'is die pad volledig' and 'die sirene lui' are two full clauses, so the comma is required.

besluite.fout: 'by die muurprop ingeprop' repeats 'prop' and names the plug where the socket is meant.
besluite.rede: Same action and same object (plugged into the wall socket), now with the right noun and preposition.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: 'Mense moet ... hoor' and 'die lig moet ... wees' are two full clauses, so the comma is required.
